properties.property: Only pending admin accepts. Acceptance clears pending state, revokes old administrative power, and keeps the explicit operator map unchanged. Zero pending admin cancels transfer.
For the actual inherited proxy, only operators can forward allowed selectors. Bytes shorter than four and disallowed selectors revert. Forward exact calldata and ETH. Target failure rolls back.
assumptions: Selector permission applies to every target and all arguments. It is not a target allowlist.

properties.property: Deployment rejects zero admin or zero operator. Deployment grants exactly the configured operator role; admin is not automatically an operator.
Only pending admin accepts. Acceptance clears pending state, revokes old administrative power, and keeps the explicit operator map unchanged. Zero pending admin cancels transfer.
For the actual inherited proxy, only operators can forward allowed selectors. Bytes shorter than four and disallowed selectors revert. Forward exact calldata and ETH. Target failure rolls back.
assumptions: Selector permission applies to every target and all arguments. It is not a target allowlist.

properties.property: Deployment rejects zero admin or zero operator. Deployment grants exactly the configured operator role; admin is not automatically an operator.
Successful allocation fits absolute and relative vault caps and remaining aggregate global risk capacity. Operator also fits local risk cap. Admin bypasses local cap only.
subclaim_gaps: Symbolic adapter histories have length 0 or 2; real composition has one adapter. No proof for arbitrary adapter arrays or classifier changes concurrent with external calls.
assumptions: Unique stable adapter IDs. Truthful vault allocation/totalAssets and classifier views. Symbolic cases use counts 0,1,2,3 and explicit cap branches.

properties.property: Cap products and allocation sums do not wrap. Overflow rejects without vault calls or mutations. Under documented bounded states, valid-cap allocations succeed.
subclaim_gaps: Products and two-adapter sum overflow have explicit fixtures. Existing allocation plus request overflow has no isolated fixture; finite uint64-domain cap test covers nonoverflow branch.
assumptions: No classifier cap bound exists. For success domain require each product <= uint256.max and sums <= uint256.max. Do not claim all admin-selected values remain live.

properties.property: Forward exact adapter, assets, enum action, swap calldata and minimum unwrap output. Vault/classifier immutable getters match construction. Failure rolls back.
assumptions: Recording vault proves forwarding only; real Morpho and strategy behavior needs integration fuzz.

properties.property: Exercise actual Morpho allocation and adapter calls to test cap consistency after adapter-reported value change and liquidity-adapter routing.
subclaim_gaps: Production integration uses actual ERC4626Strategy, VaultV2, allocator and classifier with concrete 1000 assets, standard OpenZeppelin ERC4626 and one strategy. Yield, nonstandard assets, arbitrary adapters and liquidity-adapter deposit bypass remain outside this proof.
assumptions: Risk checks use requested amount while Morpho updates from adapter-reported change. Liquidity adapter actions happen outside _validateCaps. Neither is covered by a recording-vault proof.

properties.property: Verify exact submitted selectors and arguments. Add records the target MYT atomically. Remove executes against the stored MYT and deletes its mapping atomically.
assumptions: removeStrategy myt argument affects only nonzero validation/event; execution uses stored mapping. No mapping uniqueness invariant is enforced.

properties.property: Forward adapter getIdData, new cap, and mapped MYT without alteration. Reject unmapped adapter. Target revert preserves mapping and balances.
Submit the exact Morpho setter selector and arguments to the supplied MYT, and propagate target failure.
In real VaultV2, execution before maturity reverts and execution consumes the pending calldata. Re-execution requires a new submission.
subclaim_gaps: Actual VaultV2 addAdapter covers pending, premature rejection, execution and replay. Other timelocked selectors are checked for exact encoding and authority, not each full timelock execution pipeline.
assumptions: Local curator has no timelock state. Morpho is responsible for all timelock enforcement.

properties.property: Owner sets or clears only the requested vault/recipient pair. Distinct mapping keys remain unchanged. Zero keys are permitted by this implementation.
Initial owner must be nonzero. Owner transfer updates authority immediately, rejects zero, and revokes old owner access. Renounce disables owner-only writes.
Initial admin must be nonzero. Pending admin alone accepts, pending state clears, old admin loses power. Setting zero pending admin cancels transfer.
Setters and getters agree for every uint8 class. Strategy cap follows its current class. Mutating one class or strategy does not change unrelated keys. Unassigned strategy resolves to class zero.
assumptions: Caps are arbitrary uint256. There is no enforced <=1e18 bound or local<=global bound. Test storage fidelity, not an invented percentage invariant.

properties.property: Construction rejects zero token, alchemist or owner. It authorizes alchemist and initial owner. Owner alone changes nonzero-account authorization. Token getter stays immutable.

Ownership transfer changes setter authority but does not change the independent withdrawal map. Test that old owner authorization persists until explicitly revoked. Renounce leaves existing authorized accounts able to withdraw.
Authorized withdrawal moves exactly amount under standard asset behavior, rejects zero recipient/amount, and cannot exceed custody balance. Revert preserves balances.
assumptions: Standard token without transfer fee/rebase, or native ETH. Include recipient==vault separately.

properties.property: Construction rejects zero token, alchemist or owner. It authorizes alchemist and initial owner. Owner alone changes nonzero-account authorization. Token getter stays immutable.

Ownership transfer changes setter authority but does not change the independent withdrawal map. Test that old owner authorization persists until explicitly revoked. Renounce leaves existing authorized accounts able to withdraw.
Authorized withdrawal moves exactly amount under standard asset behavior, rejects zero recipient/amount, and cannot exceed custody balance. Revert preserves balances.
assumptions: Standard token without transfer fee/rebase, or native ETH. Include recipient==vault separately.

properties.property: Positive deposit increases actual ETH custody by msg.value. deposit rejects zero. receive accepts arbitrary native transfers including zero. totalDeposits equals current ETH balance.
Positive WETH deposit transfers and unwraps exactly amount, leaving that much additional ETH custody. Transfer or unwrap failure rolls back.
subclaim_gaps: Standard one-to-one WETH, transfer false/revert, unwrap failure and guarded callbacks are covered. Arbitrary WETH code or dishonest native transfer accounting is outside assumptions.
assumptions: WETH withdraw pays exactly one native wei per WETH unit. Direct WETH donation is not included in totalDeposits.

properties.property: A receiver or WETH callback cannot enter guarded deposit, depositWETH, or withdraw while a guarded call is active. An authorized receiver is used to test the guard itself.
assumptions: Plain receive remains intentionally unguarded.

properties.property: Positive standard-token deposit transfers amount to custody. Zero rejects. totalDeposits always equals token.balanceOf(vault). Token false/revert result rejects.
assumptions: Fee-on-transfer token can produce an event amount different from the balance increase. No internal depositor accounting exists.

properties.property: Callback from an untrusted token or recipient cannot gain withdrawal authority. Exercise authorized and unauthorized callback senders separately.
subclaim_gaps: One callback token tests unauthorized rejection and an intentionally authorized callback withdrawal; arbitrary recursive callback traces and malicious balance reporting are not proven.
assumptions: There is no nonReentrant guard. Trusted authorized withdrawers can already drain custody. Do not assert universal nonreentrancy.

properties.property: Mint rejects zero recipient. Successful calls issue unique increasing IDs, increment balance and supply, and skip the reset callback. Counter overflow reverts atomically.
assumptions: Use fixed bounded mint history plus explicit counter-boundary storage fixture.

properties.property: Burn removes one existing NFT, clears token approval and enumeration, and calls the alchemist reset once. Missing token and callback failure revert atomically.

Owner/approved transfer updates ownership and enumeration, preserves total supply, clears token approval, and resets mint delegation. Unauthorized transfers and failed callbacks preserve both NFT and allowance state.
subclaim_gaps: Local suite uses callback spy to prove reset call and rollback. Root owns actual Alchemist allowancesVersion integration; require its result before claiming delegation invalidation.
assumptions: Concrete bounded minted history. Safe-transfer receiver variants need fixed callback data and separate return/revert branches.

properties.property: Only owner or all-token operator can set token approval. Caller controls its operator map. Approval changes do not move tokens. Zero operator rejects.
Admin update immediately changes admin authority. Renderer setter stores exact address. Zero new admin/renderer is accepted and can disable administration/metadata.
Nonexistent token or unset renderer rejects. Configured renderer output passes through for existing token. Verify collection metadata and ERC721/enumerable interface support.
assumptions: Renderer content correctness is a separate FUZZ obligation.

properties.property: For all sampled uint256 IDs, render valid Base64 JSON and SVG with the exact decimal token ID, correct line splitting, and no reverts.
subclaim_gaps: Fuzz validation uses independent Base64 decoder/JSON parser and expected SVG fragments. It is not a universal symbolic proof or a full XML schema validator.
assumptions: Nested string/Base64 loops span thousands of bytes. This is not a formal proof over all token IDs.

properties.property: Implementation cannot initialize after construction. Proxy initializes once, sets owner and both roles to caller, sets role administrators to ADMIN_ROLE, and fixes metadata/18 decimals. Reinitialization rejects.
assumptions: Atomic proxy deployment and initialization is a deployment assumption. Proxy admin/upgrade machinery is separately scoped.

properties.property: Non-whitelisted and paused callers cannot mint. Authorized successful mint increments recipient balance and total supply equally. Nonzero bridge limit restricts mint. Zero maxLimit skips restriction.
assumptions: No global supply cap exists. Limit successful amount to available supply headroom; separately assert overflow revert.

properties.property: All four burn entry points reduce balance and supply equally. Third-party burn consumes allowance. Insufficient allowance/balance or bridge capacity reverts atomically. Self burn leaves allowance unchanged.
assumptions: burn(address,uint256) and burnFrom reduce maximum allowance too, unlike ERC20 transferFrom.

properties.property: Transfers preserve supply and exact balance deltas, including self-transfer. Finite allowance decreases, infinite transferFrom allowance persists. Approval updates do not transfer value. Invalid/overflow cases revert atomically.
Reachable bridge current limit stays between zero and max, depletes exactly on mint/burn, refills to max after one day, and adjusts remaining capacity correctly on max changes.
subclaim_gaps: uint96 success domain and fixed monotone times; explicit uint256.max readable-cap liveness candidate is kept failing rather than assumed away. Partial-time burn refill is covered through shared production routine but test directly samples only mint partial refill and burn full-day refill.
assumptions: Monotone realistic time; timestamp+86400 fits. Admin limits need explicit overflow cases because source accepts arbitrary uint256.

properties.property: Fee setter rejects fee>=10000. Supported-token fee is floor(amount*fee/10000) below positive amount when product fits. Other token returns zero maximum and rejects fee query. Overflow rejects atomically.
assumptions: maxFlashLoanAmount has no source bound. Restrict normal success amount<=uint256.max/fee and record this limitation.

properties.property: Valid flash loan mints principal and burns principal+fee, decreasing final supply by fee. Wrong token, excess amount, callback failure, insufficient final balance and nested loan revert.
subclaim_gaps: Receiver fixture covers standard repayment, callback rejection/revert, insufficient fee, and blocked nested loan. Arbitrary borrower action sequences are not covered.
assumptions: For exact final delta receiver performs no independent mint/burn/transfer beyond repayment fixture. Fee reserve exists before callback.

properties.property: Only each role admin grants/revokes. Renounce acts only on caller account. Sentinel controls pause only. Ownership transfer does not transfer ADMIN_ROLE or SENTINEL_ROLE.
assumptions: ADMIN_ROLE is its own administrator. No DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder is assigned during initialize.

properties.property: Only current owner changes ownership. Transfer rejects zero. Renounce sets zero owner. These operations leave access-control roles unchanged.
Valid signed permit changes only specified allowance and increments nonce once. Replay, expired, wrong signer, altered value, chain/domain mismatch and malleable signature reject without nonce use.
subclaim_gaps: Crypto primitives are trusted; signed-message tests run only under Forge. Symbolic tests cover expiry/high-s gates and state rollback.
assumptions: Crypto unforgeability is an assumption. Halmos ecrecover abstraction cannot prove the cryptographic primitive.

general_limitations: No builds, solvers or fuzz runs performed by governance agent; generated tests are not proof results.
Fixtures use fixed authority addresses; mapping keys are symbolic where appropriate, but unauthorized callers are representative actors rather than a universal address-state proof.
Small numeric input types are explicit bounded verification domains, not production-enforced limits. No vm.assume or vacuous-return fuzz filters are used.
Proxy fixture uses real ERC1967Proxy with atomic initialization; proxy upgrade governance is outside token implementation scope.
Standard-token custody claims exclude transfer fees, rebases and dishonest balanceOf responses.
Wrapper fuzz tests call the same implementation assertions as symbolic tests; no new correctness is inferred merely from having a wrapper.
execution_note: No Halmos run. The final one-case Forge fixture check passed 1352 functions and failed 1; candidate tests were excluded. Individual smoke results are not formal proofs.
